text:
<@U0BTUQGHDDF> All 5 sync pods are running on the same node, and its CPU is saturated (93-99% busy).

As Shubham suggested, we can schedule this job on a dedicated node using `nodeSelector`.

Optionally. to make sure other sync pods don’t land there, add a taint on that node pool and a matching toleration in this job’s profile.
```global:
  jobProfiles:
    54:
      nodeSelector:
        <http://cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool|cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool>: "<dedicated-pool-name>"
      tolerations:
        - key: "dedicated"
          operator: "Equal"
          value: "olake-job-54"
          effect: "NoSchedule"```
